result.topic_en: Pencil drafts written on a printed postal/accounts form (No. 10) about representing a many-valued function by a surface that displays its branching, so that the function becomes a single-valued function of position on that surface; they then set up the condition for X dx + Y dy to be a complete differential on such a surface and mention converting a non-simply-connected surface into a simply connected one.

items.english: The many-valued function has only one definite value at each point of such a surface representing its type of branching, and can therefore be regarded as a uniquely determined function of position on this surface.
